blueprint_weighting.concern: Domain F drops from 15.0% to 11.0% of total active bank after combined E+F archival. However, this is a quantity reduction, not a coverage gap — all 30 unique C/D topics plus all A/B/E topics are preserved. The 39 seeds can be certified to bring Domain F to 264 Certified (up from 225).
blueprint_weighting.mitigation: Certify the 38 C/D F seeds via CAQS §1.6 to restore Domain F certification depth. Alternatively, expand Pack A/B/E Section F to add ~112 items to fully replace the archived C/D clones and maintain the 15% weighting target.

verdict: COVERAGE PRESERVED — TOPIC BREADTH INTACT, QUANTITY REDUCED

verdict_detail.topic_breadth: PRESERVED. All 30 unique C/D Section F topics are already covered by Pack A (75 topics), Pack B (16 topics), and Pack E (74 topics). Every C/D topic has coverage in at least 2 of the 3 certified packs. No topic is lost.
verdict_detail.seed_preservation: 38 seeds retained (19 per pack) — one per rotation group. All 30 unique topics have at least one active seed item.
verdict_detail.certified_pool: 225 Certified items across Packs A, B, E remain untouched. Certified pool is 100% intact.
verdict_detail.quantity_reduction: Active Domain F items drop from 375 to 263 (-29.9%). This is a pool-size reduction but not a coverage gap. The 111 archived clones were rotation-group duplicates that provided zero additional topic breadth.
verdict_detail.recommendation: PROCEED with archival. No blueprint topic gap introduced. The 38 seeds provide structural representation of all C/D F topics. After archival, consider certifying the 38 seeds to bring Domain F to 263 Certified (70.1% of total, up from 60.0%).
